timing_contract.host_scope: current-host CPU/GPU measurement; NOT Raspberry Pi UE latency and NOT OAI transport latency
timing_contract.ranker_sorting_and_selection_excluded_at: q=0 preserves its exact ranker-bypass path and never scores cells
timing_contract.torch_cpu_threads_rationale: pinned for reproducibility: at torch's 24-thread default on this hybrid P/E-core CPU the same decode call ranged 5-68 ms while its component operations summed to 3-7 ms, so the multi-thread medians measured thread-pool scheduling jitter rather than codec cost
